blocks.text: Ostentation (*riyāʾ*) is hidden polytheism (*ash-shirk al-khafī*), one of the two forms of polytheism. It consists in your seeking status in the minds of people so that you thereby obtain influence and respect. Love of influence is included in the "desires given reign to" [which are mentioned in a Tradition as destructive], and it is through this love that most people are destroyed. Yet people are destroyed only by themselves — if they really knew, they would realize that it is only their desire to show off which induced them to seek most of their knowledge and perform actions directed towards God (*ʿibādāt*) not to mention their actions directed towards their fellow-men; this showing-off renders their acts of no avail, as is found in Tradition,

"On the Day of Resurrection, orders will be given to take the martyr to Hell. He will entreat: Lord, I was martyred fighting in your path. God will retort: you wanted it to be said that so-and-so is brave, and that was already said, and that is your reward. The same will be said to the religious scholar, to the man who has performed the pilgrimage to Mecca, and to the reciter of the Qurʾān."
